gazette_location.description_raw_en: The continuation of KWAI TAI ROAD as a thoroughfare, which was published under Government Notice No. 2859 dated 25 November 1977, and running in a west south-westerly direction for about 16 metres, where it bends to run in a west north-westerly direction for about 149 metres where it then turns to run west south-westerly for about 219 metres and then bends again to run in a south-westerly direction for about 107 metres to terminate at the waterfront as shown coloured red and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R80A.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路屬一九七七年十一月二十五日第二八五九號憲示所公佈之葵泰路之延伸部份，向西南偏西伸展約十六米，後改向西北偏西伸展約一四九米，再轉向西南偏西伸展約二一九米，然後改向西南伸展約一零七米至海傍處終結；在NTA/TW/R80A號圖則內以紅色及黑斜綫顯示。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare commencing at the termination of HING FONG ROAD (which was gazetted under Government Notices Nos. 1023 dated 19 April 1974 and 44 dated 5 January 1979) and running in a south-westerly direction for about 863 metres, where it bends to run in a west south-westerly direction for about 774 metres over Tsing Yi Bridge and RAMBLER CHANNEL, and terminating at its junction with two un-gazetted roads on Tsing Yi Island as shown coloured red and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R80A.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由興芳路末端開始（該路已於一九七四年四月十九日第一零二三號憲示及一九七九年一月五日第四十四號憲示公佈在案），向西南伸展約八六三米，再改向西南偏西伸展約七七四米，橫跨青衣橋及藍巴勒海峽，至與青衣島兩條未命名道路之連接處終結；在NTA/TW/R80A號圖則內以紅色及黑斜綫顯示。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Cul-de-sac commencing to the south-west of WAH YIU HOUSE, LAI YIU ESTATE, and running in an easterly direction for about 43 metres where it turns to run in a northerly direction for about 79 metres, then bends to run generally west north-westerly for about 262 metres, then turns to run in a southerly direction for about 113 metres, and turns to run in an east south-easterly direction for about 177 metres, then bends to run in a south south-easterly direction for about 140 metres, and then bends again in an easterly direction for about 18 metres where it terminates as shown coloured red and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R80A.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此盡頭路由麗瑤邨華瑤樓西南面開始，向東伸展約四十三米，後改向北伸展約七十九米，再改向西北偏西伸展約二六二米，再轉向南伸展約一一三米，後改向東南偏東伸展約一七七米，再改向東南偏南伸展約一四零米，然後再轉向東伸展約十八米止；在NTA/TW/R80A號圖則內以紅色及黑斜綫顯示。
